entities.name: User
entities.rationale: Stick-figure actor labeled USER on the far left; issues an https request (handwritten URL) that points down into Route 53.

entities.name: Route 53
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_6 at (771,372), labeled ROUTE 53. Standalone icon, receives the user's https request and points to ALB.

entities.name: ALB
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_5 at (941,373), labeled ALB. Standalone icon, receives arrow from Route 53 and has a line going down/right toward the Spot instances.

entities.name: EKS
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_3 at (1103,378), labeled EKS. Drawn inside a dashed container together with the SPOT icon below it; the hand-drawn microservices (M.S.1, M.S.2, M.S.3) are linked to it by a curved line.

entities.name: Spot Instances
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_1 at (1110,526), labeled SPOT (EC2 Spot Instances icon). Located inside the same dashed container as EKS, directly below it, acting as the worker nodes for the EKS cluster; an arrow from it points to the hand-drawn node circle hosting microservices M.S.1, M.S.2, M.S.3.

entities.name: SNS
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_4 at (1257,377), labeled SNS. Outside the dashed EKS/Spot container on the right; receives an arrow from the container and has a small arrow down to SQS.

entities.name: SQS
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_2 at (1260,522), labeled SQS. Directly below SNS; receives a small arrow from SNS and a long curved line from the microservices area arriving from below.

visual_connections.description: Line from the user up to a handwritten https URL, with an arrow pointing down into the Route 53 icon.
Horizontal arrow from Route 53 to ALB.
Line leaving the right side of ALB, going down and ending in an arrowhead at the left of the SPOT icon inside the dashed EKS container.
Curved line from the left side of EKS sweeping down to microservice M.S.1, which runs on the node circle fed by the SPOT icon; EKS and SPOT also share the same dashed container.
Line rising from the EKS/Spot container area (right side, near SPOT) with an arrowhead pointing into the left of SNS; represents microservices publishing to SNS.
Small arrow pointing down from SNS to SQS.

Long curved lines looping from the microservices (M.S.1 / node circle hosted on Spot) under the diagram to an arrowhead at the bottom of SQS; direction ambiguous, drawn with the arrowhead at SQS and another at M.S.1 (microservices consuming from the queue).
